parameter_count_method: Sum tensor numel except persistent buffers. FMN parameter/buffer names cross-checked against local named_parameters/named_buffers; sequence heads and ATST checked against pinned constructor code. Count both stored strong and weak heads; TF includes 32 frozen rotary frequency parameters (RotaryEmbedding learned_freq=False).

atst_fp16_activation_estimate.assumed_per_block: QKV 3D + FFN expansion 4D + four D residual/norm tensors; two attention matrices
atst_fp16_activation_estimate.limitation: Analytical retained-tensor approximation, not measured peak or upper bound; excludes additional backward tensors, dropout masks, FFT/convolution workspace, allocator fragmentation and PyTorch implementation effects. GPU T0 remains required.
